welcome: Welcome to the website of the Kingdom of Eleuedla
info-p: The government is an absolute monarchy located in California. It is distinguished from other micronations, because it explicitely believes in Integralism and Catholicism.
legislation-p: The Kingdom of Eleuedla has legislation from the present day all the way back to the Provisional State of Clovisia.
